summary: Tested AI Match Score feature for CV Search. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: AI Match Score button visible on candidate cards, job selector dropdown works, Score button triggers AI analysis, result displays inline with score percentage, reasoning, breakdown (Skills/Experience/Location), and skill tags. Close button returns to idle state. Job seekers correctly denied access to CV Search.
critical_code_review_comments: AI Match endpoint correctly requires recruiter auth and CV Search tier access (Growth+)
Caching works correctly - returns cached=true for previously scored candidate/job pairs
ObjectId serialization handled properly (pop _id after insert_one)
Job selector dropdown correctly shows only recruiter's active jobs
Score button disabled until job is selected (good UX)
Loading state shows 'Analyzing match...' during AI processing
Result display includes all required elements: score %, reasoning, breakdown, skill tags
Close button properly resets state to idle
Job seekers correctly denied access - CV Search link hidden and direct URL redirects away
data-testid attributes present on all key elements for testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Match Score feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) POST /api/cv-search/ai-match requires recruiter auth + Growth+ tier, returns 400 without candidate_id/job_id, 404 for non-existent job, 403 for job seekers. 2) Caching works - second call returns cached=true. 3) GET /api/cv-search/ai-match-scores returns cached scores with optional candidate_id/job_id filters. 4) Frontend: AI Match Score button appears on candidate cards in CV Search, clicking shows job selector dropdown, selecting job enables Score button, clicking Score shows loading then result inline. Result shows score %, reasoning, breakdown (Skills/Experience/Location %), matching skills (green), missing skills (red outline). Close button returns to idle. 5) Job seekers cannot see CV Search link and are redirected if accessing directly.
